title: Translocation mechanism of xeroderma pigmentosum group D protein on single-stranded DNA and genetic disease etiology.
authors: Paul, Tanmoy; Yan, Chunli; Derdeyn-Blackwell, Grant; Ivanov, Ivaylo
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子模拟和路径优化方法研究XPD/DinG在单链DNA上的ATP驱动转位机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作动态机理建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非TF-DNA，故评7分。
abstract: XPD is a key nucleotide excision repair (NER) protein whose function is vital for genome integrity. During NER, XPD serves as a 5'-3' single-strand DNA translocase that enables lesion scanning and verification in genomic DNA. Yet, its translocation mechanism is incompletely understood. Here we use molecular simulations and chain-of-replicas path optimization methods to model the ATP-driven translocation mechanisms of XPD and its bacterial homolog DinG, revealing all on-path metastable intermediates and corresponding kinetic rates. We identify the XPD(DinG) global domain motions that modulate the strength of DNA association at the opposing ends of the DNA-binding groove. During the ATP hydrolysis cycle, alternating weak and strong interactions at two defined groove constrictions enable DNA reptation and forward displacement of the ATPase. Moreover, we show that DNA- or ATP-binding residues directly involved in translocation are hotspots for genetic disease mutations. Thus, our findings shed light on the etiology of XPD-associated genetic syndromes.
abstract_zh: XPD是一种关键的核苷酸切除修复（NER）蛋白，其功能对基因组完整性至关重要。在NER过程中，XPD作为5‘-3’单链DNA转位酶，能够实现基因组DNA中的损伤扫描和验证。然而，其转位机制尚未完全阐明。在此，我们利用分子模拟（molecular simulations）和副本链路径优化方法，模拟XPD及其细菌同源物DinG的ATP驱动转位机制，揭示所有路径上的亚稳态中间体及相应的动力学速率。我们识别出XPD(DinG)的全局结构域运动，这些运动调节DNA结合沟槽相对两端DNA结合强度的变化。在ATP水解循环中，两个特定沟槽收缩处交替出现的弱和强相互作用，使DNA能够进行爬行运动并促进ATP酶的前向位移。此外，我们表明直接参与转位的DNA或ATP结合残基是遗传疾病突变的热点区域。因此，我们的发现为XPD相关遗传综合征的病因学提供了见解。
